# W276: staging-only build loop, root selection and fail-closed checks.

script/build_staging_app.sh # Thin 2.0 dispatch; preserve the original 1.0 path.

script/tatwo2-staging-codesign.sh # Stop on Keychain UI without interacting or changing identities.

scripts/rooms/staging-sync.sh # Local incremental App/receipt sync; refuse production destinations.
App/Sources/Tatwo2/Engine/NativeStagingIsolation.swift # Fixed bundle cannot bypass isolation by removing markers.
